title: pgvector: Open-source vector similarity search for Postgres
snippet: pgvector adds vector columns and similarity search (cosine, L2, inner product) directly to PostgreSQL. Good fit when you already run Postgres and want to avoid a second database.

title: Pinecone: managed vector database
snippet: Pinecone is a fully managed vector database built for production RAG at scale, with automatic scaling and no infrastructure to operate.

title: Weaviate: open-source vector search engine
snippet: Weaviate is an open-source vector database with hybrid search (vector + keyword) and built-in modules for embeddings.

title: Milvus: vector database for AI applications
snippet: Milvus is designed for billion-scale vector search with multiple index types (IVF, HNSW, DiskANN) and horizontal scaling.

title: Choosing a vector database for production RAG
snippet: For small to medium datasets already on Postgres, pgvector avoids operational overhead. For very large scale or when you need a dedicated managed service, Pinecone or Milvus are usually recommended instead.

title: Why pgvector is not enough at scale
snippet: Some practitioners argue pgvector's HNSW implementation lags behind dedicated vector databases like Milvus for very large (100M+) datasets, disagreeing with the common 'just use pgvector' advice.
